source_tables: Tabella 7-1 (MIL05 emergency generators 1-10) and Tabella 7-2 (MIL06 emergency generators 11-23), section 7.3.1, of 'Studio della dispersione degli inquinanti in atmosfera' (R090_23_R1-MIL05-MIL06-ATM, issued 30 November 2023) in the Bornasco VIA (ID_VIP 10891)
source_crs: UTM zone 32N on WGS84 (EPSG:32632), as printed ('Coordinate UTM WGS84'; model domain centre 'UTM WGS84 32N')
method: Arithmetic mean of the 23 generator-stack coordinates (MIL05 and MIL06) in EPSG:32632, inverse-projected to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (no datum change); shapely 2.1.1 used for distances
identity_cross_check: The CTVA opinion of 15 June 2026 annexed to decree DM 633/2026 states that the whole site will have 23 emergency generators (about 163 MWt), that MIL05 is the south building and MIL06 the north building of the campus, and that the lot (cadastral sheet 14, parcels 31, 32, 370 and 372 of Bornasco; 165,351 m2) lies north of Via dei Pioppi in the ATP1 transformation area. The ten MIL05 stacks lie at 5,011,225-5,011,348 N and the thirteen MIL06 stacks at 5,011,366-5,011,482 N, i.e. south and north of the mean point respectively.
imagery_check: Qualitative only: in an Esri World Imagery export in EPSG:32632 (esri-ms-bornasco-utm32.jpg) the stacks fall on graded open ground crossed by an internal track, north of a tree-lined road and the Zeccone settlement, with the northern MIL06 stacks partly on the adjoining unworked field; no building is visible. The imagery date is not stated and the graded ground is not used as a status observation.
